name: Simon Peter
summary: A fisherman whom Jesus called to follow Him, and one of the twelve apostles. He confessed Jesus as the Christ, denied Him three times on the night of His arrest, and later preached boldly in Jerusalem.

key_moments.title: Catches a Net Full of Fish
key_moments.description: After a night of catching nothing, Simon let down his nets at Jesus' word and caught so many fish the nets broke. He fell at Jesus' knees, and Jesus told him that from now on he would catch men.

key_moments.title: Walking on the Water
key_moments.description: Jesus came to the disciples walking on the sea, and Peter stepped out of the boat to go to Him. When he saw the wind he grew afraid and began to sink, and Jesus caught him.

key_moments.title: Confesses Jesus as the Christ
key_moments.description: Jesus asked His disciples who they said He was. Simon Peter answered that He was the Christ, the living God's Son, and Jesus called him blessed.

key_moments.title: Denying Jesus Three Times
key_moments.description: After Jesus was arrested, Peter followed at a distance and three times said he did not know Him. Then a rooster crowed, the Lord looked at Peter, and Peter went out weeping bitterly.

key_moments.title: Preaching at Pentecost
key_moments.description: Peter stood up and told the crowd in Jerusalem that God had raised Jesus from the dead. He told them to repent and be baptized, and about three thousand were added that day.
